name: Mixed Races
overview: Scripture addresses the topic of mixed races with both divine order and spiritual unity in view. Leviticus 19:19 and Deuteronomy 7:3 emphasize God's commands against mixing different kinds, including in marriage, to preserve the holiness of His people, as further lamented in Ezra 9:2 regarding the mingling of the 'holy seed' with foreign peoples. Yet, Acts 17:26 reveals that God created all nations from one blood, establishing their boundaries and times, and Galatians 3:28 proclaims that in Christ, distinctions such as Jew or Greek are transcended, affirming unity in salvation while maintaining respect for God's ordained distinctions.
